compatibility_findings.finding: The accepted compiler, assessment history, ledger locator and schemas are v1-only. They must remain unchanged while SOURCE-SEMANTICS adds separate v2 schemas/modules and an explicit compiler v2 profile.
compatibility_findings.required_test: Run all prior v1 vectors and compile outputs unchanged; send every v2 wire/event/record to v1 validators and assert stable refusal.

compatibility_findings.finding: compile-input.v1 cannot carry a paper-record.v2, source associations, display head, Markdown locators, evidence profiles or v2 events. A complete prospective mixed inventory therefore requires a new closed input schema and adapter; it must not be accepted by widening v1 validators.
compatibility_findings.required_test: Compile legacy-only, v2-only and mixed inventories through the future v2 API; prove the legacy page bytes remain equal when its input and related set are unchanged.

compatibility_findings.finding: The design requires a half-open Unicode span over exact decoded UTF-8 material and forbids normalization/line-ending rewriting. The new contract must freeze whether offsets count decoded Unicode scalar positions or UTF-8 byte offsets; tests must exercise both interpretations and reject ambiguity.
compatibility_findings.required_test: Use combining marks, precomposed characters, emoji, CRLF/LF, internal U+FEFF, and a non-ASCII multi-byte excerpt with exact boundary checks.

compatibility_findings.finding: assessment_history.v1 binds the old PDF/code evidence fingerprint and has no profile field. A v2 event must carry explicit profile and one boundary invalidation referencing the prior v1 head/claim snapshot; a second independent v2 genesis would violate the one-authoritative-history rule.
compatibility_findings.required_test: Preserve old v1 event bytes, append exactly one v2 boundary invalidation to provisional, derive one current v2 head, and refuse v2 human review before invalidation.

observed_contract: claim and event shapes are closed and assessment-event.v1 only
claim_id and claim text/evidence fingerprint are cross-bound
exactly one connected, nonforking genesis-to-head chain per claim
human transitions retain fingerprint; invalidation changes it and returns provisional
all supplied history is bounded and caller objects are not mutated
compile_pages validates video-paper-wiki.compile-input.v1 and each paper record as paper-record.v1
_paper requires complete claim set and derives v1 assessment heads
claim_id and evidence_fingerprint are v1 identity calls
core conclusion remains one-to-three active accepted/contested claims
output paths and case-fold/path-prefix collisions are refused
vpwiki-locator-v1 is the only accepted wire prefix
only PDF and code locators are accepted
canonical JCS envelope and exact decode-reencode spelling are required
outer evidence source_id/relation must match decoded locator
no Markdown source-version association or Unicode span exists in v1
pure bounded JSON/tree parser with duplicate-key, UTF-8, cycle and resource-limit refusal
chunk and bm25 profiles validate supplied upstream records
volatile created_at/updated_at is excluded only from runtime projection equality
Markdown equality is exact bytes; no source/path I/O

limitations: This is a design/test matrix only. No v2 implementation is authorized by this review, and no source, schema, Git, Vault or external runtime was modified.
open_freeze_items: Freeze exact v2 schema titles, source association/provenance fields, source-version conflict key, association ID/content hash formulas and registration receipt reference shape.
Freeze Markdown span unit (decoded Unicode scalar index versus UTF-8 byte offset), page-anchor relation to observation pages, and exact out-of-range/empty-span codes.
Freeze v2 evidence profile identifier, domain-separated fingerprint field order, duplicate/order policy and assessment v2 event ID formula.
Freeze paper-record.v2/compiler-v2 input shape and legacy adaptation rule, including exact provisional wording and complete mixed-inventory authority checks.
Freeze display decision/head schema and transaction successor namespace before calling any association/display state current or published.
recommended_test_layers: Contract vectors: exact JCS bytes, schema closedness, all new discriminators and resource byte hashes.
Pure semantic unit tests: association identity/reuse/conflict, display graph, Markdown locator spans and v1-to-v2 assessment migration.
Compiler compatibility tests: golden legacy pages plus complete mixed prospective inventories and hostile escaping.
Security tests: bounded input trees, no-I/O, caller immutability, stable pointer/error precedence and no v2 widening of v1 validators.
Installed-wheel tests: resource registry exposes every new schema/module byte-exactly and legacy resources continue to validate prior fixtures.
scope: Read-only compatibility and error-path review of accepted L1 source interfaces; no implementation, schema edits, Git, Vault, network or external runtime actions.
